snippet.title: Don't Mess With Bober | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
One small mistake on vacation can lead to big troubles. Are you ready for them? Are you ready to meet Bobr, who is on the path of revenge?

On July 3, the game Don't Mess With Bober will be available on Steam and VK Play!

Add to Wishlist so you don't miss it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177010/Dont_Mess_With_Bober
